node.description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'1)

Artoria Pendragon, better known as Arthur Pendragon and King Arthur, is regarded as a male in history but is actually female. She is the "Once and Future King" and a legendary hero of Britain known as the King of Knights. She used to wield the sword from the stone, Caliburn, but it was eventually destroyed and the Lady of the Lake gifted her with Excalibur and Avalon.

__In Fate/Prototype:__ ~!He is presented as male instead, conserving his original name of Arthur Pendragon. Also called Prototype Saber, he is the Saber-class Servant under the control of [Ayaka Sajyou](https://anilist.co/character/54223).!~

__In Fate/stay night:__ ~!Saber is summoned in the Fifth Holy Grail War as the Servant of [Shirou Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/496). Shirou had been having dreams of Excalibur in the days leading up to the start of the Holy Grail War after receiving his Command Spells and, while stumbling in his shed during his escape from [Lancer](https://anilist.co/character/499), Avalon, hidden inside him, reacts to the traces of a magic circle and summons Artoria as his Servant.!~

__In Fate/stay night: Heaven's Feel:__ ~! Corrupted by [Angra Mainyu](https://anilist.co/character/120855), Artoria is vastly different from her normal self. She is also called Saber Alter/Black Saber. The results of her alteration is not only within Artoria's interior but also extends to her outward appearance. The color of her skin becomes pale, and the pupil of her eyes that were at first concealed behind a black visor during the moment of her summoning becomes golden from her original green eye color as well. Because the armor she wears was dyed jet black and grew in weight due to changing into a heavier armor, its power has increased more than normal.!~

 __In Fate/Zero:__ ~!Saber is summoned by [Kiritsugu Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/10010) to participate in the Fourth Holy Grail War on behalf of [Jubstacheit von Einzbern](https://anilist.co/character/16027) and the Einzbern family. Kiritsugu partners Saber with [Irisviel von Einzbern](https://anilist.co/character/15164), to act as Saber's Master in the open while he acts from behind to win with his own methods.!~ 

__In Fate/Grand Order - First Order:__  ~! She remains the corrupted version, known as Saber Alter.!~

__In Fate/Grand Order Camelot:__ ~!The being called Goddess Rhongomyniad came into existence in the world that [Bedivere](https://anilist.co/character/8941), due to the wish of wanting his King to not perish after the battle of Camlainn, refused to throw Excalibur back into the Lake even after the third time.!~

__Height:__ 182 cm

Gilgamesh is the King of Uruk, said to have reigned during the Sumer Dynasty in Mesopotamia 5000 years ago. He's the namesake Hero described in the Epic of Gilgamesh, making him the most ancient Hero on which all the others legends were modeled. This grants him the title of King of Heroes and, within his Gates of Babylon, the prototypes of all the Noble Phantasms of the Heroes yet to come. 

Born from the human Lugalbanda, the King of Uruk, and the goddess Rimat-Ninsun, he was a being so perfect and transcendent to the point that he was two-thirds deity and one-third human. He was the chosen one that would guide humanity on the earth that was slowly abandoning the Age of Gods, but instead he grew up to be a selfish and arrogant despot.

His only friend and being he considered his equal was [Enkidu](https://anilist.co/character/60059).

__In Fate/Zero:__
~!
Initially summoned as the Archer-class Servant of [Tokiomi Toosaka](https://anilist.co/character/16017/Tokiomi-Toosaka) in the 4th Holy Grail War, using the fossil of the first skin ever shed by a snake as a catalyst, he soon becomes bored with his Master and takes interest in Kirei Kotomine. Together they plot to kill Tokiomi and forge a new pact, with Gilgamesh pushing Kotomine to accept his true desires. He also takes interest in Iskandar as a worthy opponent to kill, and in Artoria, a tragic figure to take as his bride. 

In the end, invested by the pollution of the Holy Grail, he is gifted a mortal body and is reincarnated in the world. !~

__In Fate/strange Fake:__
~!
Within the World of Fate/strange Fake, Servant Archer Gilgamesh was previously summoned in the Fourth Fuyuki Holy Grail War and participated in the Fifth Fuyuki Holy Grail War. But the Servant summoned in the False Holy Grail War is a new Servant without any memories of the Fuyuki Holy Grail Wars. 

He is the first Servant summoned in the True and False Holy Grail War as the "False" Archer-class Servant of [Thine Chelc](https://anilist.co/character/87307/).
!~

Born as Sètanta from a mortal woman, Deichtine, and the Sun God Lugh he's a Hero from the Ulster Cycle of Irish Mythology. He took the name Cú Chulainn after he killed the guard dog of the blacksmith Culann, said to be stronger than 10 men, when he was only a child. To make up to the old blacksmith he offered himself as a guard dog and since then was called Cú Chulainn, "Culann's savage dog".

Trained in the Arts of the Spear and magic Runes by Scáthach, he wields the cursed Gàe Bolg, the spear that inflicts wounds that never heal. 


__In Fate/Stay Night:__ 
~! 
Originally the servant of [Bazett Fraga McRemitz](https://anilist.co/character/24332/Fraga-McRemitz-Bazett), he becomes the Servant of [Kirei Kotomine](https://anilist.co/character/506/Kotomine-Kirei) after Kirei fatally wounds Bazett and remains under his command for the duration of the War. !~

__In Fate/Grand Order -First Order:__
~! 
He is a Caster-class servant. Unlike the other Servants, he's not blackened and aids [Mash](https://anilist.co/character/120735/Kyrielight-Mash) and [Ritsuka](https://anilist.co/character/120734/Fujimaru-Ritsuka) in their task !~

__In Fate/hollow Ataraxia:__ 

~!
[Caren Hortensia](https://anilist.co/character/46957/Hortensia-Caren) acts as his Master.!~

__Height:__ 159 cm (5'3)

Ruler's True Name is Jeanne d'Arc, the Saint of Orleans. A Catholic saint born in Domrémy, France, and the heroine of France who liberated Orléans in the Hundred Years' War.

A Ruler Class Servant is the Standard-Bearer who Correctly Guides the Holy Grail War. Jeanne is a special Heroic Spirit summoned by the Holy Grail itself to act as the administrator of the Holy Grail War instead of the Church. Being summoned in the Ruler class also allows her to retain the memories of each repeating "game" unlike other Servants.

Jeanne d'Arc was a common farmer's daughter. She claims she had received the command of God to fight. She heard the Lord’s lament that the world changed straight into hell. The Lord wept into sorrow as no one could stop it and people were not even allowed to live simply, and were compelled to become either beasts or food. Conflict never ended, and blood continued to rain incessantly and soak the land. She received a revelation from the Lord, the voice contained no glory or victory, no obligation or sense of purpose but only the Lord laments. She caught his small, feeble murmurs that everyone else failed to hear. 

Jeanne also has a minor cameo in the second season of Fate/Zero.

Mordred is the "son" of [King Arthur](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) though, in reality, she is a woman. 

[Morgan le Fay](https://anilist.co/character/239533/le-Fay-Morgan), Artoria's sister, created Mordred as a homunculus clone of the King. Morgan grew Mordred in secret, inculcating her the desire to usurp the King and ascend to the throne as the rightful heir. To achieve this objective Mordred was made to be one of the Knights of the Round Table. 

With time Mordred grew to idolize her "father", but the King refused to recognize her as a rightful heir. These clashing feelings of love and hate made Mordred play an important role in the fall of Camelot.

__In Fate/Apocrypha:__
~!Mordred is the Saber-class Servant of [Kairi Shishigou](https://anilist.co/character/122397/Shishigou-Kairi) as part of the Red Faction in the Turifas Holy Grail War.!~

~!Medusa is a Greek mythological figure described as a winged human female with living venomous snakes in place of hair. Those who gazed upon her face would turn to stone.
 
With her older sisters [Stheno](https://anilist.co/character/191058/Stheno) and [Euryale](https://anilist.co/character/191065/Euryale), they made up the three Gorgon Sisters who inhabited the Shapeless Isle. She came into existence thanks to the thoughts and prayers of humans, who desired a perfect goddess, but she was cursed for her beauty and turned into a monster hated by all. She is thus not a Heroic Spirit but a monster closer to a Divine Spirit. 

Due to her nature, she can manifest through different aspects depending on which disposition is predominant (more or less monstrous)!~
 
__In Fate/stay night:__
~!She is the Rider-class Servant of [Shinji Matou](https://anilist.co/character/501/Matou-Shinji) in the Fifth Holy Grail War of Fate/stay night.!~

__In Fate/stay night: Heaven's Feel:__
~!She only truly acts as [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/500/Matou-Sakura)'s Servant when their connection is revealed in Heaven's Feel.!~

__In Fate/Grand Order - First Order:__
~!She is a Lancer-class Servant. Medusa is Blackened, a process by which a being is tainted by an outside force, causing their personality to be reversed toward the orientation of evil.!~

__In Fate/Grand Order: Absolute Demonic Front Babylonia:__
~!In this singularity Medusa manifests as two separate beings: 

One is Ana, a Lancer-class Servant without a Master. This incarnation represents the young Medusa, from a time when she wasn't known as the monster inhabiting the Shapless Ile. Though still wary of humans for casting her away, she is much closer to the perfect Goddess she was supposed to be.

The other one is Gorgon, an Avenger-class Servant. This incarnation represents Medusa as a man-eating monster. The burning hatred against the humans that exiled her and her sisters led her to become the very monster they accused her to be. Gorgon wields Tiamat's Authority which grants her the ability to generate Demonic Beasts.!~

name.native: マシュ・キリエライト

node.description:
Mash Kyrielight is a clerk at Chaldea and a Shielder-class Demi-Servant contracted with [Ritsuka Fujimaru](https://anilist.co/character/120734/Fujimaru-Ritsuka) in Fate/Grand Order. The title Demi-Servant indicates that she's a human bonded with a Heroic Spirit's Soul.

~!
In the year 2000, Mash was created through artificial fertilization and genetic editing. She is actually a Designer Baby, a magus genetically engineered under the orders of Chaldea's late director, ‎[Marisbury Animusphere](https://anilist.co/character/147492/Animusphere-Marisbury), to be a prime vessel for a Heroic Spirit's soul. Since she's not dissimilar to a Homunculus, her lifespan is limited.!~

~!
The Spirit possessing Mash is none other than [Galahad](https://anilist.co/character/136944/Galahad), Knight of the Round Table, the saint said to be the only one who obtained the Holy Grail only to return it to the Heavens. He was summoned using his shield as a catalyst, carved directly from the Round Table itself. Galahad tried to resist being forcefully bonded to Mash, attempting to destroy the Chaldean researchers and their equipment but was stopped by Mash's resistance. Weary that if he left completely the girl who was bound to him would die he chose to hibernate within Mash!~

name.native: ネロ・クラウディウス
alternative: Nero Claudius Caesar Augustus Germanicus (ネロ・クラウディウス・カエサル・アウグストゥス・ゲルマニクス)

node.description:
Nero Claudius Caesar Augustus Germanicus, the Fifth Roman Emperor, had the reputation of a notorious tyrant whose rule was made up of schemes and poison as she oppressed all religious forces, especially Christians, and the Roman Senate during the period from 50 to 60 AD. She was regarded in the same light as the devil, for the assumed Hebrew pronunciation of her name as emperor, Nero Caesar pronounced as "NRVN QSR", equates with the "Number of the Beast". 

__In Fate/Extra:__
~!One of three Servants available to the protagonist of Fate/Extra. While she was notorious as a tyrannical emperor and for her arrogance as an artist with supremacy comparable to the gods, She is a kindhearted individual who wanted what was best for her subjects.!~

__Height:__ 159 cm

Ishtar is the goddess of beauty, good harvests, war, lust, discord, and fertility in Mesopotamian/Sumerian/Babylonian Mythology, and one among the many mother goddesses whose power is derived from the Earth Mother. Said to be the most pampered goddess of them all, her whimsical and egotistical personality tends to make her a nuisance for everybody around her. 

Among the Gods, she is one that presents many Authorities, the power of a Divine Spirit to change reality at will appealing to their status as Gods and their domain over certain aspects of the world. 

~!Due to their nature, Ishtar and [Ereshkigal](https://anilist.co/character/150759/Ereshkigal) are always summoned together and inhabit the same body. !~

__Height:__ 159 cm

Ereshkigal is the Goddess and ruler of the Netherworld in Sumerian Mythology. She and [Ishtar](https://anilist.co/character/135743/Ishtar) are sister goddesses, polar opposites representing life and death, thus holding a rival relationship.

She was assigned to oversee the Netherworld at birth and upheld her duty with utmost care but inevitably started envying the freedom and carefreeness of her counterpart Ishtar opposed to the utter solitude she was bound to endure. While her sister was revered and pampered Ereshkigal desired nothing more than for someone to see her as she truly is, to not be judged for being the avatar of death.

~!Due to their nature, Ishtar and Ereshkigal are always summoned together and inhabit the same body.!~

Enkidu is known to be [Gilgamesh](https://anilist.co/character/2514/Gilgamesh)'s only true friend and much like him, they regard their friendship highly. 

While they may have the appearance of a human they're nothing more than a doll made of mud, shaped and given life by the Gods. Before assuming their current form and acquiring intellect and knowledge, they spent a long time roaming the forests and thus has a deep connection with nature.

The task given to them was to reprimand Gilgamesh tyrannical behavior and bring him back into the service of the Gods but the might of the two was equal and they developed a tight bond fighting together. 

__In Fate/Grand Order - Absolute Demonic Front: Babylonia__
~!
Enkidu's corpse, which was buried in the graveyard of the underworld, was taken. Kingu is a chimera created from Enkidu's corpse, although the puppet itself does not find out until later on.
!~

__In Fate/strange Fake:__
~!
Class name, False Lancer, is the "False" Lancer-class Servant summoned by the [Wolf](https://anilist.co/character/138619/) in the True and False Holy Grail Wars of Fate/strange Fake.
!~

name.native: ジャンヌ・ダルク・オルタ

node.description:
Also known as Jeanne Alter, she is the Alter version of [Jeanne d'Arc](https://anilist.co/character/67769/dArc-Jeanne). Although designated an Alter, it does not mean that she is a different aspect of Jeanne d'Arc. A Jeanne of vengeance that [Gilles de Rais](https://anilist.co/character/16024/de-Rais-Gilles), the French Army's marshal who grieved for Jeanne d'Arc's death, fabricated by means of the Holy Grail shortly after the execution of Jeanne in 1431. As a Heroic Spirit that is an exact opposite of the proper Jeanne, she is manifesting in the Avenger Class.

__In Fate/Samurai Remnant:__ 
~!Unlike the Jeanne Alter from Fate/Grand Order, Jeanne d'Arc herself transformed into an Altered state due to unique summoning circumstances that lead to her sacrificing her saintly purity.!~

Merlin is believed to be the son of the Princess of Wales and an Incubus, his mixed blood and his astounding talent for magic make him one of the greatest Mages that ever lived and one of the few qualified to be a Grand Caster. Like all the most supreme mages he possesses powerful Clairvoyance abilities. Merlin's, however, allows him only to see the present. 

He served first [Uther Pendragon](https://anilist.co/character/316370/Pendragon-Uther) and then his heir [Artoria](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) as a counselor and court mage, aiding her during her reign. He, however, disappeared soon before the fall of Camelot into the mists of Avalon. There, locked in a tower, he is unable to die and observes the world through his clairvoyance.

Since he is not technically dead and registered in the Throne of Heroes, he couldn't be summoned as a Servant, however, the mischievous Merlin has a hobby of bypassing this rule through loopholes.

Ushiwakamaru, mainly known by her adult name Minamoto no Yoshitsune, is one of the most famous military figures of Japanese history with only the likes of [Oda Nobunaga](https://anilist.co/character/127210/Oda-Nobunaga) rivaling her fame.

Said to have been trained in the arts of war by a Tengu when in the care of Kurama Temple, she is a master of the combat arts but her peculiar upbringing and natural talent made her impervious to the worries of the average soldier. 

__In Fate/Grand Order: Absolute Demonic Front Babylonia:__
~!Ushiwakamaru appears as a Rider-class Servant summoned by [Gilgamesh](https://anilist.co/character/2514/Gilgamesh) to protect Uruk's Northern Wall. She is friendly and cheerful yet displays great ability and hardheadedness in battle. Ushiwaka is touched by knowing her legend and sacrifices managed to survive, instilling respect even in people far into the future like [Ritsuka](https://anilist.co/character/120734/Fujimaru-Ritsuka). 

She acts as a bait in the battle against [Gorgon](https://anilist.co/character/502/Medusa) in the city of Nippur, allowing her allies to retreat. Despite displaying incredible speed through her Noble Phantasm she is ultimately defeated and captured.!~

Lancer of Red is the Lancer-class Servant of Shirou Kotomine of the Red Faction in the Great Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha. Originally summoned by one of the five puppet Masters of the Red Faction, he later becomes one of the Servants of Shirou.

~!Lancer's identity is Karna, Son of the Sun God, the invulnerable hero of the Indian epic Mahabharata. Karna was born between a human mother Kunti and the Sun God Surya. As proof of being the son of Surya, he was given a golden armor that granted invulnerability. Karna was born to become a great hero. However, Kunti abandoned Karna and became the queen of King Kuru. Not knowing who his mother was, Karna grew up with a low social status. However, he soon made his existence known to the world by becoming the honored guest of the Royal House Kauravas, who were hostile to King Kuru. Karna participated in the wars around the borders and fought on an equal footing with Arjuna, son of Kunti and Thunder God Indra. Karna eventually fell in battle after being robbed of his golden armor by Indra, suffering many curses, and losing all of his allies. He died in the hands of his half-brother Arjuna. However, he did not hate anyone and accepted his death.!~

(Source: Type-Moon Wikia)

A beautiful woman who served [Emperor Toba](https://anilist.co/character/394909/Toba-Tennou) said to be the disguised figure of the white-faced, nine-tailed fox. Her childhood name was Misukume. Working in the palace since she was 18 years old, she later became a court lady of Emperor Toba under the name of Tamamo-no-Mae. She was said to have gradually gained the favor of Emperor Toba with her beauty and extensive knowledge. 

In reality, she is a soul that branched off from [Amaterasu](https://anilist.co/character/394908/Amaterasu) and her true identity is not that of a nine-tailed fox, but rather is treated as one of the facets of said goddess. It is wrong to categorize her as a Heroic Spirit though she manifests as such because she wished to "become a good wife"

The Tamamo Nine are a group of nine Heroic Spirits consisting of Tamamo-no-Mae and eight Alter Egos of her. 

__In Fate/Extra__
~!She is a Caster-class Servant. It is revealed that she was once the Servant of the game's final antagonist [Twice H. Pieceman](https://anilist.co/character/189968/Pieceman-H-Twice) before he gained [Saver](https://anilist.co/character/189970/Buddha). Twice kept losing and respawning in the war and, eventually, lost Caster.!~

Quetzalcoatl is a Deity worshiped in many Mesoamerican cultures, with different names depending on the population, and depicted as a Feathered Serpent or with various degrees of anthropomorphic features. 
Worshiped as the god of Sun, wind, arts, crafts, and knowledge; he is said to have greatly contributed to human culture through gifts such as agriculture and fire. Often also associated with Venus as the Morning Star, from which derives a certain affinity for warfare. 

In the world of Fate, Quetzalcoatl manifests as a joyous woman with a strong passion for Lucha Libre. Despite that, she can be ruthless in attacking enemies.

__Height:__ 187 cm

Sir Bedivere was among the first Knights of the Round table, and he remained faithful to the [King](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria) until the end. 

Although he was the one who closest guarded the King, he never saw her smile nor learned of her identity as a woman. After attending the King's death he found himself initially unable to return Excalibur to the [Lady of the Lake](https://anilist.co/character/333146/Vivian), for that would signal Artoria was truly gone. Though sad the hard work of his King was not properly rewarded, he understood her Fate could not be changed and finally returned the Sword, hoping she would find a peaceful slumber.

__In Fate/Grand Order Divine Realm of the Round Table:__

~!In this version of History he was unable to return Excalibur, making it impossible for Artoria to pass away and reach Avalon. He has been wandering the Earth for 1500 years, wrought with guilt, trying to finally complete the task the King assigned him!~

Ritsuka Fujimaru is the protagonist of Fate/Grand Order, acting as the Master of many Servants for the purpose of solving the Grand Order conflicts. He has absolutely no background details or connections to other people or events. He is simply "someone who just happened to see a recruitment flyer at a station, applied and got accepted into the job, and somehow ended up getting taken into the Chaldea Security Organization.'' 

He is a rather mediocre magus with skills comparable to Lord El-Melloi II.
 
~!After the events of First Order, Ritsuka is the only magus available to tackle the Singularities thus becoming the epitome of the everyday man tasked with saving the world!~

name.native: レオナルド・ダ・ヴィンチ

node.description:
Leonardo is an individual from the 15th-16th century, revered as one of the greatest geniuses of human history. 

Often called The Almighty for his vast knowledge and deep mastery of every craft, from Arts to Science. Despite not being from a long-running lineage of Magi, and not having any Magic Crests, DaVinci still excelled at Magecraft thanks to diligent study. 

DaVinci is the Third successful Summoning performed at Chaldea. Summoned when the system was still incomplete, she had limited time at her disposal, but curious about Chaldea's circumstances, and convinced by [Romani](https://anilist.co/character/137154/Archaman-Romani), she decided to stick around. To do so she created a duplicate puppet to act as her Master through a masqueraded contract. This is also the reason why she can't fight, she needs a real Master to actually become a full-fledged Heroic Spirit. 

Though normally male, when summoned he takes the appearance of Mona Lisa. He pursued ideal beauty in life so he is content in becoming the embodiment of ideal beauty in death.

__Height:__ 191 cm   
__Weight:__ 81 kg  

In Fate/Zero
    ~!Berserker is the Servant of Matou Kariya during the 4th Holy Grail War. Berserker is known to have three distinct Noble Phantasms, as shown on his status page. However, due to the enchantment that obscured his identity, his status page was shown blurred, making it impossible to identify the specific names and natures of his Phantasms, save for the sword Arondight. In addition, this Berserker is uniquely able to make anything he chooses into his own Noble Phantasm and effectively wield them, from telephone poles to the Noble Phantasms of other Servants.
Berserker's real identity is Lancelot of the Lake. Until his identity was revealed, he had been known simply as the Black Knight.  Lancelot, known as the Knight of the Lake, had been loyal to Artoria, knowing both the king and the secrets of her sword well. Lancelot's downfall began when he loved Artoria's queen. Though the king was actually a woman, Artoria had married in order to present the image of a stable royal family before the kingdom and to maintain the illusion that she was a man in the face of the general public. Her queen willingly sacrificed her own life as a woman in order to fulfill the ideal of the stable government. However, Lancelot and the queen fell in love. Though he wanted to take her away, Lancelot's loyalty to Artoria and his sense of duty to serve the kingdom prevented him from doing so. When political enemies of the king exposed Lancelot and the queen's affair, the queen was ordered to be executed. Left with little choice, Lancelot rebelled in order to try and save her. The knight, the queen, who had made her beloved betray his duty, and the king, who felt responsible for the despair her most loyal servant endured, all suffered. Though Lancelot suffered greatly, he found that he could not hate Artoria, who had never blamed Lancelot for anything regarding the state of affairs they had become entangled in. In his despair, Lancelot desired to become a beast who had no worries; thus, when he became a Heroic Spirit, he became a Berserker-class spirit. !~ (Source: Wikipedia)

Romani Archaman, nicknamed Dr. Roman, is the head of the medical department and later acting director of Chaldea Security Organization during the Grand Order conflicts of Fate/Grand Order.
~!
Romani's true identity is Solomon, the King of Magic. He was summoned by [Marisbury Animusphere](https://anilist.co/character/147492/Marisbury--Animusphere) and participated in Fuyuki's Holy Grail War, in 2004, emerging victorious. His wish to the Grail was "to become human" and he was thus reborn as a normal person.!~

Founder of the Hashshashin sect and the 1st to take the name Hassan-i-Sabbah and the mantle of Old man of the Mountain. 

Nothing is known of his original identity or his existence, not even to the other Hassan successors. 

King Hassan chose to serve as a Judge, observing the Hashshashin sect and its leaders, assuring they were always respecting the old doctrines. If the current leader strayed from the path or was too weak, in body and mind, King Hassan would come to reclaim their head, to ensure the Sect's survival. 
To adhere to the noble task of an Assassin of Assassins, he doesn't use hidden weapons but he's clad in armor and wields a greatsword, fighting the enemy head-on. 

As the wielder of the title of Grand Assassin and being the peak of this Class, King Hassan has become as one with Death itself. 

Azrael the Pale is King Hassan’s younger self from before he took up the role of Old man of the Mountain. As Azrael he dwells in Hell and has been appointed as Chaldea’s supervisor representing the Grand Servants.

name.native: オルガマリー・アニムスフィア

node.description:
Olga Marie Asmleit Animusphere, also known as Olgamally Animusphere, is the daughter of Marisbury Animusphere and heir to the Animusphere family of magi, one of the top 10 families in the Clock Tower. 

She joined Chaldea initially as a Master candidate though she had to step up and assume the control of the Grand Order operation after her father's death. Though severe, arrogant and uptight she still shows compassion and cares for her subordinates within the organization. She trusts and relies on Lev Lainur as a fellow researcher and for support in her duties. 

__In Fate/Grand Order - First Order__
~!
She is apparently Rayshifted to Singularity F together with Fujimaru and Mash but in reality, only her consciousness was shifted while her body died in the explosion that engulfed the laboratory. Returning back to the current era would mean her mind would die.

This truth is revealed to her by Lev himself, who comes out as the traitor who set the explosives in an attempt at killing all the Chaldean Masters and personnel. To smack her even more, Lainur uses the power of the Holy Grail to cast Olga within CHALDEAS. Since the machine is a miniature reproduction of the Planet comprised of potentially infinite data, being cast within is akin to being sucked into a black hole.!~

name.native: フランシス・ドレイク

node.description:
She was the renowned explorer who successfully became the second person alive who circumnavigated the globe, paving the way for England to become the dominant superpower of the Age of Discovery with its earnings. She also played a significant role in the defeat of the Spanish Invincible Armada and brought Spain - which was called "the Kingdom on which the sun never sets" - to the edge of collapse.   

In Fate/Extra 
~!She is a Rider class servant under the control Shinji Matou.!~

 (Source: Type-Moon Wikia)

One of the nineteen leaders of the Hashshashin sect who took the name Hassan-i-Sabbah and the mantle of Old Man of the Mountain.

Though appearing as a young innocent maiden she is a methodical and impassable assassin using her shapeshifting capabilities and abilities with poison to great effect. She in invulnerable to toxins and her own body has become a lump of poison itself. From her nails to her skin, her mere touch is deadly. 

Unlike other Hassan, who carve out their faces to nail the skeletal mask to their skin, she only wears a normal mask for her face is one of her greatest weapons. She usually plays the part of a lover of the victim to earn their trust. Years of false relationships and feigned happiness bear heavily on her mind.

node.description: One of the Primordial Deities in Mesopotamian/Sumerian Mythology. Before being called Tiamat, she was known as the Goddess of Beginning, the primordial sea, Nammu. Along with Abzu, she was manifested from the Sea of Dawn—an Ocean of Void that lies below the Underworld of Ereshkigal, said to have once been under the administration of the god Enki.

Jaguar Man is a low-grade Divine Spirit, worshipped in Mesoamerican civilizations of old as a symbol of war and death. It is often referred to as Nagual, a human being capable of shapeshifting into a Jaguar.

Fou is one of the main characters of Fate/Grand Order, acting as a mascot of sorts. It's a squirrel-like creature, "a cute animal" that appears to be able to freely walk around the Chaldea Security Organization. 

It is met by Fujimaru while it's alongside Mash and accompanies the two in their travels to different Singularities.

~!Fou is Merlin's familiar and a creature belonging to the Beast class, holding the title of Beast IV!~

node.description:
The great hero of the Indian epic, the Mahabharata.

The Mahabharata is a dazzling story where the heroes of India gather, and it's no exaggeration to say that Arjuna is at the center of them all.

__In Fate/Grand Order Cosmos in the Lostbelt:__ 

~!Known as God Arjuna in life, Arjuna Alter is a version of Arjuna that absorbed all the gods of the Hindu pantheon (with exception of Ganesha and Kama), losing most of his humanity in the process and became the last god in the Indian Lostbelt.!~
A priestess and personal assistant to Gilgamesh. She is wise, beloved by the people of Uruk and speaks to the King with sincerity.

Caster of Red is the Caster-class Servant of Jean Rum of the Red Faction in the Great Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha.

Placing the importance of the Story above all else, he lies and cheats and by any means conduct himself that he might witness the unfolding of a grand tale, beautiful beyond compare. Consequently, he tends to distance himself from mentality of the "participant," taking instead the perspective of an abstract, "Authorial" third person. His regard for others differs by individual, dependent on their qualification as a special existence, or "protagonist." He interacts with "normal humans" only in a shallow, dismissive manner, and expresses an extreme interest in "protagonists." In slight narcissism, he frequently drops such self-authored quotes as, "Things bad begun make strong themselves by ill." He's taken a liking to certain terminology from modern fiction, such as "Death-Flagging." With short and effective words, he brings to light that what humans usually keep hidden. This is like suddenly being poked by rambling, incongruous words, so one would probably feel shocked.

As the world is the greatest story ever told to him, or so it ought to be in his eyes, he willingly employs deception, provocation, or anything else for the sake of spinning the story. He greatly loves those who are out of the ordinary from the bottom of his heart, perusing the tales they spin. With greatly exaggerated outbursts of emotion, he acts as he wishes, gracefully admitting that it is suitable to call him a trickster.

~!Caster's true name is William Shakespeare (ウィリアム・シェイクスピア), a poet and playwright from the Elizabethan England.
His father was an affluent man in Stratford, but it is uncertain if Shakespeare received a higher education. Half of his life is shrouded in mystery and there are many mysteries in his career, such as an undocumented gap of seven years. In his early days as a playwright, his productions revolved around comedy, then historical drama, before he changed his style for magnificent tragedy. At the same time, he also played as an actor in the underground, and he was the target of slander and derision from influential people. In any case, he just had to write a few works and his reputation didn't know where to stop. Considering how he was belittled by a senior playwright as a "upstart Crow" at the time, it seems that he was quite envied.
He is the only playwright whose fame has reached around the world, he is representative of authors of the western world. His name shines brilliantly on the history of English literature, his popularity as a great man from England is the highest possible. Still having a large influence over modern literature, it can be said that those with no knowledge of his works are to be disparaged as ignorant. It is also said that those looking to trace the source of any piece of modern literature will always find a Shakespearean creation. Having written too many masterpieces to list, his four greatest tragedies rising above all others are "Othello," "Macbeth," "Hamlet" and "King Lear."!~

(Source: Type Moon Wikia)

King of Sparta, despite the gruff and muscular appearance he's a cunning tactician though he doesn't betray his Spartan origin and fights like a brute.

In time of great peril, when Greece was threatened by an invasion of the Persian Achaemenid Empire, he and 300 brave Spartan soldiers managed to hold back Xerxes I's 100.000 man army all by themselves in the Battle of Thermopylae. For three days they fought, and while none survived, their sacrifice gave time to the City-States of Sparta and Athens to regroup their armies and repel the invasion  

In Fate/Grand Order: Absolute Demonic Front Babylonia

~!Leonidas is summoned as a Lancer-class Servant and serves as the commander of the forces stationed at the Northern Wall of Uruk, constantly keeping the invading Demonic Beasts at bay. His positive attitude and teachings give faith to the people of Uruk in their survival and serve as example of the undying spirit of mankind.

Leonidas dies turning into stone while making a last stand against Avenger with his Noble Phantasm: Thermopylae Enomotia. Before passing away he reveals his opponent's true name, the terror remembered by all Greek people, Gorgon.     !~

__Height:__ 180cm

One of the Knights of the Round Table that appeared in the Arthurian legends, also known as the White Knight of the Round Table.
If King Arthur was the night, the symbol of the moon itself, then Sir Gawain was the day, which shoulders the sun. He acted as [King Arthur](https://anilist.co/character/497)'s impersonator in the royal castle of Camelot. In other words, he was one of the candidates to substitute the King after his fall. He is the bearer of the sister-sword to Excalibur, Excalibur Galatine.

__In Fate/Extra,__ ~!he's summoned by [Leonardo B. Harwey](https://anilist.co/character/127156) as a Saber-class Servant for the Moon Holy Grail War, bein the last Servant that [Hakuno Kishinami](https://anilist.co/character/84485) faces. Later, with their defeat, Leo finally learns of defeat and thanks Gawain for his services; Gawain points out to him that he was honored to witness an honorable king before fading away.!~

__In Fate/Grand Order Camelot,__ ~!Gawain, along with the other Knights who swore allegiance to the [Lion King](https://anilist.co/character/497), slew the remainder of the Round Table (including his little sister Gareth), and was, like the others, given a divine Gift to help him "pacify" the people of the Singularity, that being the Gift of Nightlessness: making the sun shine anywhere he goes even at night ensuring he is at his peak at all times. Gawain is placed in charge of the Holy Gate, the entrance to the White City of Camelot.!~

name.native: シャーロック・ホームズ
alternative: The One who Illuminates the Truth

node.description:
Sherlock Holmes, the world's greatest, most famous and sole consulting detective, the genuine father of all detectives. The crystallization of the concept of detectives, the representative of "the Revealers". The protagonist of the stories written by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle in the 19th~20th centuries, and the detective that solved every mystery, and in the many mystery novels written after, he is one of the progenitors of "Detectives". Or so it is said. But is that really the truth?

Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's novels were the memoirs of his companion and assistant, Dr. John Watson. Holmes works as a consulting detective in London and is famously based in a flat at 221B Baker Street. He has handled many requests, and has definitely gotten a fair share of serious cases from the London Metropolitan Police Department (Scotland Yard), some of which even involved the English government. He has a doctorates in medicine, economics and law and is a member of the Royal Society, and he is especially well-versed in pharmacy.

Holmes and Watson were investigating the death of Henry Jekyll. Holmes received a letter prior from his death, the letter explaining about his failed experiment and his Hyde persona. Holmes was convinced that the Clock Tower was involved with "The Incident of Jack the Ripper".

The Heroic Spirit Holmes, who resembles the men he was modeled after, such as Joseph Bell, Doyle himself, or the oldest detective in the world, Vidocq - he was summoned into this world as none of the above, but rather, as the protagonist of a series of novels (for his words and actions cannot be thought of those other than that of a protagonist's). In the end, was the story of Sherlock Holmes really a complete work of fiction penned by Sir Doyle, or was it the biography of the actual Holmes as written by Dr. John H. Watson? Perhaps it was somewhere in between the two? At the very least, Holmes himself should know the answer, but it's not a topic he brings up himself, and when the issue does come up in conversation, he always deftly evades the question. His greatest Nemesis was James Moriarty.

(Source: typemoon.fandom.com)

One of the nineteen leaders of the Hashshashin sect who took the name Hassan-i-Sabbah and the mantle of Old man of the Mountain.

In battle, this individual employs throwing daggers and has modified his body with the hand of an evil spirit which curses humans to death.

The Demon God King, the aggregate form of Solomon's seventy-two Daemons. To begin with, the 72 Demons were "a system to efficiently promote proper reason" invented by the founder of (human) Magecraft, Solomon.

~!Goetia was originally created as a magical ritual to look after mankind after Solomon's death, the Human Order Correction Ritual. Said system grieved and raged against the relationship between King Solomon and humans, becoming a curse that takes action to conquer “the imperfectness of humans” that King Solomon continued to ignore. It eventually changed into the Human Order Incineration Ritual. A magecraft with its own will that was devised in order to attain true wisdom, and is now attempting to reach the origin while making use of the entire human history.

After King Solomon’s death, the 72 demons that were sealed away inside his corpse awakened to their own ideology, swindled Solomon’s name and embarked on a new venture to convert the entire mankind into energy.!~

The tale of Tristan and Iseult, the woman he loved, is a legend boasting outstanding popularity in Europe. Tristan served the king as a good knight— and the king too had a deep trust in this handsome knight.

This particular individual suffered from Multiple Personality Disorder which he utilized to compartmentalize his abilities. Better known with his childhood name, Kintarou, Kintoki was one of Minamoto no Yorimitsu's Four Heavenly Kings.

node.description:
Berserker, as Hyde, has an appearance similar to a werewolf with black fur covering his body, a large jaw, sharp fangs, and a beast-like, humanoid form. His eyes glow upon seeing the full moon.

As Jekyll, he is shown to be fancily dressed in a white dress shirt, an olive green vest, and a black and grey jacket draped across his shoulders. He wears a black and white handkerchief with a red jewel around his neck, and leather gloves over his hands.

After Jekyll is corrupted by the Holy Grail, he takes on a darker appearance. Jekyll now wears black clothes and has gold eyes.

Since Hyde has also become the main personality as a result of the corruption. he can only maintain his human form for an hour at most. But when he does become human, Hyde takes on a appearance similar to his Assassin form only now he has fangs and claws where his hands are supposed to be.

Musical genius of the 18th century, one of the most prolific and influential composers of the classical era. 
In the world of Fate, he is believed to have been part of the Mage's Association. 

As a Heroic Spirit, his music magic derives from Orpheus and allows him to execute attacks using sound as a medium.

Berserker of "Red" (“赤”のバーサーカー, "Aka" no Bāsākā) is the Berserker-class Servant of Deimlet Pentel of the Red Faction in the Great Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha. Shirou Kotomine assumes command over him before he even meets his Master, but Berserker goes rogue before Shirou enacts his plan to officially become his Master.

~!He is instead forced to contract with Caster of Black when captured by the Black Faction.!~
~!Berserker's True Name is Spartacus (スパルタクス, Suparutakusu), the strongest Gladiator and the ringleader who raised a large-scale rebellion of slaves in Ancient Rome known as the War of Spartacus.!~

node.description:
Edison is the King of Inventors, and lifelong rival and nemesis of Nikola Tesla. 

Born in the 19th century, he was an American inventor whose vast number of achievements are well known. Rather than being one who comes up with original concepts, his specialty was to reconstruct the work of other pioneers into a more easily proliferable forms. He was extremely dedicated to his work, sleeping only three to four hours per day and otherwise fully exerting himself in work at all times. He held cordial relationships with many other inventors, such as Alexander Graham Bell and Charles Babbage, but his rivalry with Tesla was the one exception.

Romulus is the founding father of Rome.

Romulus was born in Alba Longa, an ancient Latin city, near what would be the site of Rome's foundation. He and his brother Remus were said to be the sons of the God Mars and the vestal virgin Rhea Silvia, daughter of the Alba Longan King. When the King's brother usurped the throne, the two brothers were abandoned on the banks of the Tiber river to die. Tiberinus, God of the River, saved them and the brothers grew up nourished by a she-wolf who treated them as her cubs. 

When of age the two brothers waged war against Alba Longa and reinstated their grandfather as King, they then left to found a city off their own but contention erupted between them and Romulus killed his brother. 

Romulus founded the State-City of Rome and reigned for many years until one day he disappeared. He was deified as Romulus-Quirinus, God protector of Rome. 

As Romulus-Quirinus he wields the title of Grand Lancer.

Loyal and beloved retainer of Minamoto no Yoshitsune. 

He is not the real Benkei, in fact his name is Hitachibou Kaison(常陸坊海尊) and he was nothing more than a servant to the real Benkei and Yoshitsune, barely mentioned in history. When his companions needed him most, however, in their final battle at Koromogawa no Tate, he fled cowardly in fear of losing his life. Overwhelmed with shame he trained in esoteric Buddhist practices, achieving limited immortality, took the name of Benkei and wandered the land trying to spread the legends of his former companions. 

It's partially thanks to his efforts that the real Benkei is remembered as a folk hero. 

In Fate/Grand Order: Absolute Demonic Front Babylonia

~!A warrior monk and Lancer-class Servant that Gilgamesh summoned to assist in the protection of Uruk's Northern Wall. Tales of Benkei's heroism and prowess as a fighter have spread all over Japan and much of the world, enduring even to this day. While he is a deadly warrior, Benkei also has a softer, pacifist side that hates battle of any kind!~

Lev Lainur Flauros (レフ・ライノール・フラウロス, Refu Rainōru Furaurosu, Localised as Leff Lynor Flauros), also known as Professor Lev (レフ教授, Refu-kyōju), is the antagonist involved in the Grand Order conflicts of Fate/Grand Order.

~!Lev was born from an old magus' family line that continues before the Christian era. When Solomon died, the King of Magic made a rule, the Grand Order and their primary directive passed down through a magus' family line. In reality, Goetia arranged the Demon God to be placed in the lines of mages 3000 years ago. The magi born from mankind will pass on their myriad beliefs and theories to their descendants, but those magi who separated from the "King of Magic" have survived through the ages for the sake of this point in time. Lev was born from that line and his genes were engraved with a curse which will allow possession by the Demon God Flauros, to persist and survive until the era they are responsible, Flauros was assigned to be the one responsible for the year 2016. Flauros would be awaken in 2015, as the final supervisor and to deal with humanity.!~

node.description: Jingle Abel Meuniere is a staff member of Chaldea Security Organization in Fate/Grand Order.

Sylvia is a member of Chaldea Security Organization.

Within the anime adaptation, she is shown working during the Rayshift proceedings.

Duston is a member of Chaldea Security Organization in Fate/Grand Order.

Duston was a physicist who studied cosmic rays and worked on particle accelerators, scraping by to make ends meet. He was recruited by Marisbury Animusphere as an engineer for Chaldea fifteen years prior to the destruction of Chaldea at the end of 2017. Skeptical of Marisbury's words, he eventually agreed to take the position due to Marisbury's passion and earnestness for the project.

Duston has a dislike of Olga Marie Animusphere, viewing her as incompetent and constantly angry. He does think she held up well with everything despite her personality, thinking that they should have been more considerate of her circumstances and feeling sorry over the current state of Chaldea as of Goredolf Musik's takeover. As a normal human, he dislikes when "upstart mage jerks" make particular comments. He has come to view Chaldea as his home after spending fifteen years there.

Within the altered history of the Seventh Singularity in 2655 BC, the gatekeeper is a soldier watching over the entrance to Uruk. Ritsuka Fujimaru, Mash Kyrielight, Medusa, and Merlin encounter him upon arriving to Uruk, the gatekeeper taking special notice of Medusa, believing her to be an ordinary child. Offering her candy given to him by his daughter, Medusa reluctantly accepts it.
